issues: Missing discard-triggered ability: encode "When this is discarded, you may put it into your EX area" as an `onDiscard` ability using `moveSourceToExArea` with optional handling; implement an optional self-to-EX-area discard trigger if needed.

The ally-enter trigger is incorrectly encoded with a top-level `filter`; it should target only the follower that entered. Encode this as a granted trigger or an on-ally-enter ability that filters Shikigami followers and gives Ward to that entered follower; implement top-level trigger filtering for `onAllyFollowerEnter` or support a condition for the entering follower if needed.

The fanfare cemetery condition is wrong: "at least 7 spells and Onmyoji cards in your cemetery" means a combined count, not 7 of each or either one. Encode a single condition for combined cards matching spell or trait Onmyoji; implement a cemetery-count condition that can count cards matching class/type/trait unions if needed.

The Fanfare is encoded as choosing a keyword first and then selecting a target, but the text is "Select another iM@S CG follower on your field and give it Bane or Drain." It should select one eligible follower, then choose Bane or Drain for that same target. Encode as target-then-choose, or add engine support for choosing among keywords for a preselected target.

The activated ability target encoding is incorrect: `selfFollower` does not support a nested `filter` in the reference. It should encode selection of a Golem follower on your field using a supported filtered target selector or by adding target-filter support for `selfFollower`.

The Fanfare target is wrong: the source says "Select a card in an EX area," but the parsed target is `anyFollower`. It should transform a card in an EX area into a Dragon token; implement a target selector for cards in either EX area and use that with `transform`.

The healing condition is incorrect: "If there's a Wasteland card on your field or in your EX area" is not represented by `namedFollowerOnFieldByName: Wasteland` or plain `inExArea`. It should check for any Wasteland card on your field or any Wasteland card in your EX area; implement conditions for field/EX-area card trait presence and encode the OR with `conditionAny`.

The first effect is incomplete: "Destroy each card on the field" should destroy followers and amulets, not just followers. Encode as full-field destruction; implement an effect for destroying all cards on the field if `destroyAllFollowers`/existing ops are insufficient.

The EX-area clause is missing/incorrect: "Each player buries each card in their EX area" is not represented by `buryFieldFollowers`. Encode a mass bury of both players' EX areas; implement an operation for burying all cards from both EX areas.

The last clause is wrong: after looking at the top 5 cards, you may put any number into your EX area, then bury the rest. `searchDeckChoose` only chooses a single card. Encode selecting any number from the looked-at cards to EX area and send the rest to cemetery; implement a multi-select deck-look effect if needed.
